The Problem: Non-Compliant POS Systems in Pakistan

Many businesses in Pakistan use non-compliant POS systems that do not meet the requirements of the Federal Board of Revenue (FBR). This can lead to penalties, fines, and even business closure.

The FBR has introduced various regulations, including SRO 1006 and SRO 673, to ensure that businesses comply with tax laws and regulations. However, many POS systems in Pakistan do not meet these requirements, putting businesses at risk.

Phelix ERP is here to help. Our FBR-compliant POS system and digital invoicing software ensure that your business meets all the requirements of the FBR, reducing the risk of penalties and fines.
